title: Teaching Staff - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Teaching Staff - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College is a constituent college of the University of Delhi located in Delhi. The college offers a range of academic programs and is accredited with a NAAC A+ rating. It holds a National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) position of 31 among Indian institutions. The campus is open to visitors and students from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm, and admission enquiries can be made via the provided contact number 014836.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is part of the University of Delhi and is situated in Delhi.
The college has received a NAAC accreditation of A+.
It is ranked 31st in the NIRF national rankings.
The college’s official contact number is 014836.
Visitors and students can access the campus between 9:30 am and 5:00 pm.
Admission enquiries are available through the college’s contact information.
